_doc: Where cars stand (task 42; VIEW layer reads it, LotParking builds it when the map is made). Cause: a car stands where a person would park it: a house with room has a driveway (a paved strip from the kerb through the front fence, with a dropped kerb; a house with a garage room has a carport at the head of it), a shop, office or the car park has marked bays on its forecourt, a lot with neither gets a paved lay-by of parallel bays beside the kerb. Never on the footway, a crossing, a junction, the lawn or in a lane. Sizes in tiles (a tile is a metre).
